The '''Imperial Ministry of Tourism''' was a ministry of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] which compiled a list of locations deemed to be [[Wonders of the Galaxy/Legends|wonders of the galaxy]].<ref name="J15">''{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}''</ref>

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]] found its following locations to have made the Imperial Ministry of Tourism's Wonders of [[The galaxy/Legends|the Galaxy]] list:
*[[Tasariq City]]<ref name="J15" />
*[[Elikann Crater]]<ref name="J15" />
*[[Barimoq Crater]]<ref name="J15" />
